_note: Necessary conditions for a website (J2_OUTPUT=website). Code checks each one on the built page after every build; the site is workable only when all are met, except a "severity": "warn" one (a heuristic check: Audit weighs it, it never blocks), Audit accepts and nothing is to be confirmed. "check" names the code check (or checks) in j2.condition_met(). "plan" (optional): words a workflow in Adaptation's plan must mention, or the plan is flagged before building. "skip_when" (optional): the condition doesn't apply when "charter" (a regex) matches the charter's statement or business_type and "unless" doesn't; code then skips it in the plan check and reports it met with "why".

conditions.text: The page opens (it parses, tags balanced)
Every in-page link resolves; WhatsApp (wa.me) and tel: links are well formed
No invented content: every number, email and phone number on the page comes from the charter or the Requester's answers
Every form has a submit control and a destination (action or mailto)
A nav reaches every section, and the hero has one obvious main action
